This section explains how the automated tests work. For practical steps and input choices, start with Your first check. Unfamiliar terms are explained in the glossary.

.github/workflows/regression-tests.yml

Bundled source snapshot. Credential-like literals are omitted. Line numbers correspond to the audited repository file; this page is for reading and is not executable test code.

1 name: Run Regression tests (Qase)
2 
3 on:
4     workflow_dispatch:
5         inputs:
6             qase_report:
7                 description: 'Enabled/disabled reporting to Qase'
8                 required: true
9             qase_api_base_url:
10                 description: 'Qase API URL'
11                 required: true
12                 default: 'https://api.qase.io/v1/'
13             qase_project_code:
14                 description: 'Qase project code'
15                 required: true
16                 default: 'TR'
17             qase_run_id:
18                 description: 'Qase Run ID'
19                 required: true
20             qase_run_complete:
21                 description: 'Qase Run autocomplete'
22                 required: true
23 
24 jobs:
25     link_run:
26         runs-on: ubuntu-latest
27         env:
28             QASE_TESTOPS_PROJECT: ${{ inputs.qase_project_code }}
29             QASE_TESTOPS_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.qase_run_id }}
30             QASE_TESTOPS_RUN_COMPLETE: true
31             QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN }}
32             QASE_API_BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.qase_api_base_url }}
33             QASE_MODE: 'testops'
34         steps:
35             - uses: cskmnrpt/qase-link-run@v2
36               env:
37                   QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN }}
38 
39     run_tests:
40         needs: link_run
41         runs-on: ubuntu-latest
42         permissions:
43             contents: write
44             pull-requests: write
45         strategy:
46             fail-fast: false
47             matrix:
48                 shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
49         env:
50             QASE_TESTOPS_PROJECT: ${{ inputs.qase_project_code }}
51             QASE_TESTOPS_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.qase_run_id }}
52             QASE_TESTOPS_RUN_COMPLETE: true
53             QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN }}
54             QASE_API_BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.qase_api_base_url }}
55             QASE_MODE: 'testops'
56             QASE_FALLBACK: 'report'
57             QASE_REPORT_DRIVER: 'local'
58             QASE_REPORT_CONNECTION_FORMAT: 'json'
59             QASE_REPORT_CONNECTION_PATH: './build/qase-report'
60             CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID }}
61             CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET }}
62             BASE_URL: ${{vars.BASE_URL}}
63             STRIPE_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_PUBLIC_KEY }}
64             STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY }}
65 
66         steps:
67             - uses: actions/checkout@v4
68 
69             - name: Set up Node.js
70               uses: actions/setup-node@v6
71               with:
72                   node-version: lts/*
73                   cache: 'npm'
74 
75             - name: Install dependencies
76               run: npm ci
77 
78             - name: Cache Playwright browsers
79               uses: actions/cache@v4
80               id: playwright-cache
81               with:
82                   path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
83                   key: playwright-browsers-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
84 
85             - name: Install Playwright browsers
86               if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
87               run: npx playwright install --with-deps
88 
89             - name: Install Playwright system deps
90               if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit == 'true'
91               run: npx playwright install-deps
92 
93             - name: Run tests
94               run: npx playwright test --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/6 --workers 4
95               continue-on-error: true
96
